title: Pessimistic RC retry reuses a stale scalar-subquery constant and commits mixed-attempt data

payload.p_check: a non-correlated scalar subquery was evaluated successfully during expression rewriting
payload.q_claim: the resulting Constant in ExecStmt.Plan remains valid for every transparent statement attempt
payload.failure: pessimistic RC retry refreshes the statement TS and ordinary reads but reuses the old plan constant
payload.terminal_effect: UPDATE and COMMIT succeed with new route 300 but aggregate 30 from the failed attempt; one-shot current-generation value is 1029
payload.production_workload: batch route allocation plus account or ledger aggregate snapshot
payload.settings: MDL ON; pessimistic default; max retry count 256 default; READ COMMITTED common non-default isolation
payload.topology: one TiDB, three TiKV, two SQL sessions
payload.post_red_dedup: no exact issue or PR; distinct from CTEStorageMap root #69826

provenance.source: TiDB 531e40c local and d573e28 testbed 8196300; issues closed until independent RED

payload.candidate: planning or rewrite executes a data read and embeds its result, transparent retry refreshes an input generation but reuses the plan, and another executor read reaches an irreversible consumer from the new generation
ranking_signals: EvalSubqueryFirstRow or equivalent data access during planning
ordinary Constant or scalar plan field carries the result
retry refreshes statement TS snapshot schema policy or metadata
fresh and stale paths jointly control key row image action or error
required_gates: prove retry count or equivalent owner transition
enumerate legal one-attempt outputs under the same isolation
run no-retry controls on both sides of the publisher commit
refresh only the plan-derived owner for a counterfactual
observe public terminal result and fresh durable state
payload.negative_screen: if any no-retry execution under the contract reaches the same mixed output, retain it as an allowed-outcome negative rather than a bug

payload.fresh_path: rebuilt executor ordinary join and table reads

name: RC retry must not consume a scalar constant from an older statement attempt

payload.p_check: scalar subquery evaluation returned value 30 under attempt generation g1
payload.q_claim: the embedded plan constant is valid after transparent re-entry
payload.fault: unique route 200 is claimed after preprocessing and forces a retry that advances statement TS to g2
payload.red: retry count 1, success, route 300 plus values 31/32 while new-generation scalar would yield 1030/1031
payload.green: rebuild plan after failed-attempt rollback; retry count stays 1 and values become 1030/1031
payload.contract: one RC attempt uses one statement TS for both scalar and joined source reads

name: RC retry output versus complete one-attempt generation set

allowed_set: publisher after statement TS => old scalar plus old source
publisher before statement TS => new scalar plus new source
required_observations: no conflicting target key for zero-retry arm
payload.negative_calibration: under RR the transaction snapshot and DML current read can legally produce old/new without retry

provenance.source: id2730003 RC matrix plus prior RR negative asset

name: Concurrent route allocation while a batch stores an aggregate snapshot

payload.production_workload: pessimistic RC batch UPDATE joins a configuration table for a unique route and stores a scalar ledger inventory or balance aggregate
payload.natural_producer: another allocator inserts a new business row that claims the old route and contributes to the aggregate, then advances the configuration
payload.public_result: UPDATE affected two rows and COMMIT succeeded
payload.durable_result: fresh session sees a new route with a stale aggregate while ADMIN CHECK remains green
payload.non_trigger: no retry, or default RR where the mixed visibility is already legal

provenance.source: real-TiKV schedule with SLEEP only as a deterministic window compressor

name: Preprocess then publish then conflict then retry generation

timeline: A allocates RC statement TS g1
A evaluates and embeds data-dependent scalar result
B claims the first-attempt unique key and advances all relevant source state
A reaches pessimistic locking and receives a retryable conflict
retry owner allocates RC statement TS g2 and rebuilds executor from retained plan
fresh observer compares every generation-bearing field
required_inequalities: scalar evaluation completes before B commit
B commit precedes first-attempt LockKeys conflict
retained plan constant was produced under g1
controls: remove conflict to force zero retry
rebuild the plan after failed-attempt rollback

name: Natural unique-route claim after scalar preprocessing

payload.natural_event: a concurrent transaction inserts a row owning the unique value selected by the first attempt and advances the source configuration
payload.retry_effect: the old unique key causes a supported pessimistic write conflict; the retry reads the new unique value and succeeds
payload.schedule_compressor: SLEEP in an outer assignment only widens time between scalar preprocessing and final locks

name: RR snapshot plus current DML read legally permits scalar/source mixing

payload.observation: pessimistic REPEATABLE READ with zero retry durably produced the same old-scalar/new-current-read shape
payload.reason: the scalar consistent read belongs to the established transaction snapshot while DML current read may observe a newer generation
payload.reuse: this negative blocks an overstrong same-final-state oracle and points the matrix toward RC where both reads share one attempt statement TS

lessons.result: the scalar result survives an accepted RC retry

code_ref.counterfactual: roll back failed attempt and call RebuildPlan before buildExecutor when scalar subqueries were preprocessed

lessons.result: refreshing only the retained plan-derived owner closes the mixed generation
lessons.scope: counterfactual owner proof, not final performance-sensitive fix

lessons.result: SQL-only natural unique-key conflict reproduces persistent logical corruption on real TiKV
lessons.severity: high silent data integrity; structural checks do not detect it

evidence.publisher: src advanced from 200 to 300 after scalar scan started
evidence.verdict: old scalar plus old statement source

lessons.result: without retry a publisher after the RC statement TS cannot produce old scalar plus new source
lessons.oracle_value: excludes the candidate output from the legal one-attempt set

rationale: The scalar Constant is the concrete plan-derived value whose attempt-generation certificate is omitted.
The RR negative prevents a fresh-final-state differential from being mistaken for a retry contract violation.
The business allocator supplies the natural publisher and unique-key conflict for the schedule.
The allowed one-attempt generation set distinguishes the retry corruption from legal isolation behavior.
The allocator workload supplies a production-reachable producer for both source change and unique-key conflict.
The schedule places publication between scalar preprocessing and first-attempt final locking.
The natural unique-route claim is the retry producer used by local and real-TiKV RED runs.
